readerCopy.body: A difficult history can become easier to carry when it no longer has to fit one clean explanation before anyone is allowed to move on. When Neptune sextiles Chiron, compassion and sensitivity cooperate, allowing distance, art, rest, or an honest conversation to loosen the demand for a simple verdict. An experience can contain loss and learning, gratitude and regret, care and disappointment at the same time. Meaning can become more flexible without changing the facts.
